text: Narayan Donaldson, Integrated Mobility Consultant, Mobycon, will address the TTC Board. This presentation will discuss the strengths and weaknesses of the Transit Signal Priority (TSP) system used on Toronto’s streetcar, bus and LRT systems, compare it to a TSP system commonly used in the Netherlands, and suggest areas of improvement. Narayan Donaldson has been invited to present to the TTC Board in accordance with Section 11 of the TTC By-law to Govern Board Proceedings
The Toronto Transit Commission received the Presentation: Opportunities to improve Transit Signal Priority in Toronto for information.
